name: its-plugins
description: Ian T Small's personal Claude Code plugins, usable across projects and organizations.

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Shared Claude working-practice guidance, mostly based on the Marquet leadership-language framework (Turn the Ship Around, Leadership Is Language) — one skill per play (control the clock, commit vs comply, red/blue work, intent-based language) — plus speak-plainly, a separate practice for accessible output.

plugins.name: speak-plainly
plugins.description: A separate personal practice about output register, not from Marquet's leadership-language framework: drop jargon and slow down when tired, overloaded, or asked directly — plain words, active voice, one idea per sentence, load-bearing paths and commands kept exact. Standalone version of the skill also bundled inside `playbook`.
